description: REEF3D::HYDRO rain-on-grid (R 10 1, 36 mm/h) and a point source of 1 m3/s (R 40) on a valley of 1000 m x 100 m (10 m cells, side slopes 5 %, channel slope 1 %, free outfall), semi-implicit: the channel level lies below the bed of the banks. The face predictor weights the cells by their water above the higher bed of the face (patch 0009); before, the channel pushed half its momentum through the thin bank faces and set off surges at the outlet (+-1 m3/s on 2 m3/s). 500 steps (about 40 min) cover the surges of the old scheme. Validated in Dropbox HYDRO/validation/10_sflow_surges.
